description: Constructor-based policy registry for TS model transferability pipelines. Canonical benchmark policies are generated from grouping, metric, and branch definitions.

policy_branches.description: Allow both fixed-slope and free-slope equations to compete within the policy.
Restrict the policy to fixed-slope equations only.
Restrict the policy to free-slope equations only.

policy_groups.candidate_pool_definition: Eligible donors are admissible models from the same study cell as the closest admissible model to the target anchor.
Eligible donors are all models that pass the admissibility gates for the target anchor.
Eligible donors are admissible generalized or group-level models rather than species-specific equations.
Eligible donors are admissible models assigned to the same NMDS cluster as the target anchor.

policy_metrics.aggregation_definition: Select the single eligible donor equation with the smallest combined species-study distance; ties are resolved deterministically by the policy ranking code. The biomass multiplier is computed afterward from the selected equation relative to the reference anchor.

Aggregate eligible donor equations by taking the final kernel/admissibility-weighted mean of the standardized slope and intercept. The biomass multiplier is computed afterward from the aggregated equation relative to the reference anchor.

Aggregate eligible donor equations by taking the unweighted arithmetic mean of the standardized slope and intercept. The biomass multiplier is computed afterward from the aggregated equation relative to the reference anchor.

Select the single eligible donor equation with the smallest survey-metadata Gower distance, using combined distance as a deterministic tie-break. The biomass multiplier is computed afterward from the selected equation relative to the reference anchor.

Select the single eligible donor equation with the smallest numeric taxonomic distance to the anchor, using combined distance as a deterministic tie-break. The biomass multiplier is computed afterward from the selected equation relative to the reference anchor.

Select the single eligible donor equation with the smallest species-distance term after excluding same-species donors, using combined distance as a deterministic tie-break. The biomass multiplier is computed afterward from the selected equation relative to the reference anchor.

Bootstrap-averaged random single-model selection: draw n_random_draws models uniformly at random with replacement from the eligible candidate pool and return the mean slope and intercept. Provides a null-model baseline for benchmarking other policies.
